chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, Iblees, upon him be the Curse of Allah, sends out the armies of the night from when the sun sets and emerges. Therefore, increase the remembrance of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, during these two hours, and seek Refuge with Allah from the evil of Iblees and his armies, and shelter your young ones during those two hours, for they are the two hours of negligence.
ai.seo_question: What are the two times of day when Iblees sends his armies and how should one protect oneself?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies sunset and sunrise as critical windows of spiritual vulnerability where Iblees actively deploys his forces, labeling these periods as 'times of negligence' (sa'ata ghafala). This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on proactive spiritual defense through increased dhikr and specific supplications for both adults and children to counteract these daily metaphysical shifts.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Iblees<sup>la</sup>, upon him<sup>la</sup> be the Curse of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, sends the armies of the night from when the sun sets and emerges, therefore frequent the Mention of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic during these two timings, and seek Refuge with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from the evil of Iblees<sup>la</sup> and his<sup>la</sup>. Shelter you young ones during these two timings, for these two are timings of negligence’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from abu Jamilah from Jabir from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Satan, may Allah’s condemnations be upon him, spreads the armies of the night at sunset and at sunrise. You must speak of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, very often in these two hours and seek protection from Allah against the evils of Satan and his army, protect your little ones in those two hours; they are the hours of negligence.”
